notes: HAND-DERIVED, NOT RECORDED. The sandbox that produced this file has no .NET SDK and no NuGet access, so BaselineRecorder could not be executed. Every matchScore, isRecommended flag, result position and reason string below was derived by tracing SchemeMatchingService.MatchSchemesAsync as of Phase B task 5.3 against Data/SeedData.cs. It is NOT yet trustworthy as an oracle. Before Phase E relies on it, run 'dotnet run --project tests/baseline/BaselineRecorder' and commit the regenerated file: only recordedAt, handDerived and the estimatedEmi values should change. Any other diff is a hand-derivation error in this file, and BaselineEqualityTests will say so. estimatedEmi is null throughout because the EMI formula raises (1+r) to the tenure power in double precision, which cannot be reproduced by hand; the test skips null values.
